reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice, adhering strictly to delivery policies, human-in-the-loop controls, and the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The argument flows logically with plain language, sharp scoping, and immediate clarity regarding why dashboards fail and how to diagnose the issue.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, bounded diagnostic method: choosing one dashboard, writing a three-part rule, and determining whether to automate or hold back.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported customer, performance, or capability claims, correctly framing pilot mechanics, no-lock-in account handoffs, and safety limits.
